focus: routing authority and release hygiene: release-wide version identity, a policy-version-independent durable authority event, first-class Auto, monotonic epochs, lean-mode authority durability, provenance labels, and v0.15.3 release gates
fixes: release-wide version bump to 0.1.1-rc.3 (root + all 231 matching release members): v0.15.1/v0.15.2 code no longer shares one immutable package identity; guards and the packed gate assert the new version, including on the built tarball

new durable model/selection-authority event declared in dsh-agent (always composed, not the opt-in router), carrying authority, source, authorityEpoch, and its own authoritySchemaVersion — never a router policy version

authority reconstruction is latest-deciding-record-wins with policy asymmetry: authority events and legacy explicit/foreign/subagent barriers decide at ANY policy version; only router-owned route continuity is policy-version filtered — a future router upgrade cannot erase a recorded user or SDK choice

clearExplicitModelSelection: Auto is a first-class state — explicit authority releases back to automatic routing durably, surviving restarts; the router re-scores leftover heavy headers under automatic authority
nextAuthorityEpoch never resets: continues above every persisted epoch across authority events of all schema versions and the legacy v0.15.2 routing-decision carrier
authority events are unconditionally durable (never gated by router config or recordAllDecisions); foreign/subagent passthroughs that end prior router ownership record even in lean mode

provenance labels on every deliberate selection surface: web picker (source web, authority user), SDK initialize (source sdk, authority sdk), with api/cli/system sources available; same-authority re-selections do not spam the stream
model/routing-decision gains routingDecisionId (outcome/cost join key) and activeAuthority (session authority in force); its authorityEpoch becomes a read-only legacy field
verify:model-router-v153 source guard + qualify:model-router-authority-v153 executable suite wired into check:all, check:ci, and release:verify alongside the existing gates
packed verification asserts the package version on the built artifact

authorityModel.epoch: session-level, monotonic across restarts, policy migrations, and schema versions
authorityModel.auto: clearExplicitModelSelection releases authority to automatic routing durably

routingPolicy.calibrationContract: no single family can reach the default threshold alone; enforced at config load
routingPolicy.markerIndependence: normalized cross-family, intra-family, and built-in collision checks at config load

targetedExecutableChecks.note: 48 router tests plus broad surrounding regression coverage; the new dsh-agent authority suite (5 tests) is counted under core/agent

sourceGuards: verify:model-router-v15 pass; verify:model-router-v152 pass; verify:model-router-v153 pass; verify:model-router-packed pass (version assertion + tarball + isolated consumer)
workspaceConstraints: clean for every touched package; no new findings
preExistingBaselines: packages/core/session repair.spec.ts expectation mismatch present in the original v0.14.1 upload, untouched
packages/runtime/* compile and constraint failures identical in the unmodified baseline; full-workspace tsc -b still cannot complete in the clean archive environment
remainingBoundaries: first-class AuthorizedModelSelection contract on LlmCallConfig remains deferred; the authority event stream is now the durable authority record
web picker Auto button is Control Center frontend work; the library operation ships in v0.15.3
discovered-escalation triggers remain volume heuristics; verification failures, repair rounds, tool errors, and reasoning pressure are v0.16 signals
fullMonorepoCiBoundary: Pre-existing packages/runtime/* failures block the full workspace build in the clean archive environment; the packed gate builds and verifies the router's own closure from a clean tree instead.
